observations.footwork: Fighter in white moves forward in small, controlled steps toward the fighter in dark.
observations.guard: Both fighters maintain a high guard with hands up.
observations.upper_body: Torsos remain upright, slight forward lean from the fighter moving.

observations.footwork: Fighter in white steps back and then shuffles laterally to the right.
observations.guard: Hands remain in a high guard.
observations.upper_body: Minimal upper body movement, focus remains on foot placement.
observations.distance: Distance opens as the fighter in white retreats.

observations.footwork: Fighter in white moves forward again, finishing with a wider stance.
observations.upper_body: Slight rotation accompanies the forward movement.
observations.notable: Forward step into a wider, more stable stance.

observations.footwork: Fighter in white recovers, stepping back to a normal stance and returning to initial position.
observations.upper_body: Body realigns to a neutral position.
observations.distance: Distance between the fighters returns to the initial spacing.

movement_events.detail: Forward step into a wider stance.
Recovery steps returning to the original stance and position.
